title: Lost in the Forest!
summary: I followed a yellow butterfly into the forest, and suddenly, where was home? But out from between the trees came the Wise Men of Chelm, with a long rope, a big sack and very funny advice. Then, clip-clop, Hershele arrived in his wagon with Glutzi the horse, Chamulik the dog sniffed out the way, and Pluti the little goat hopped along with us. A funny rhyming story about an adventure in the forest and the way back home to Mom and Dad.
pages:
I walked through the forest, one step, then one more,
chasing a yellow butterfly that danced and would soar.
A tree, and a tree, and another green tree,
and suddenly... where was home? It was so far from me!

I sat on a stump and cried, "Oh no! Oy-oy-oy!"
Then from the trees I heard: "Hoy-hoy! Hoy-hoy!"
And out of the bushes came a long, long line
of old men in hats, a real parade, how fine!

"We are the Wise Men of Chelm, we can solve any problem!"
"Let's measure the forest!" Reb Zainvel said with a shout,
and they wound a long, thick rope around tree after tree, all about,
around and around, and around once more,
till the wise men were all tied together, for sure!

"We'll put the path in a sack!" said Reb Todros with a smack,
"And drag it home! Pull hard, hard, hard, and don't look back!"
They dug, and they filled, and they tied, and they lifted: OOP!
And who flew into a puddle? Reb Todros: PLOP!

Then round Reb Feivel said, "Here's a clever thought, you'll see:
If we all get lost, then no one's alone! That's the answer, agree?"
"We are the Wise Men of Chelm, we can solve any problem!"
They shut their eyes and spun and spun, and got lost, every one of them!

The wise men opened their eyes, and who did they see? Me!
"We found a child!" shouted Reb Feivel. "Here he is, right next to me!"
I was so happy, my heart went BOOM-BOOM!
Now all we needed was to find my home, and soon!

Then, CLIP-CLOP! From the trees came a wagon rolling through,
pulled by Glutzi the horse, with a yellow mane too.
And on it sat Hershele, a candle burning at noon so bright:
"I'm looking for a child! Maybe he's between the ears? Let me shine my light!"

Then down jumped Chamulik the dog, WOOF-WOOF, with a leap!
He sniffed the ground, and the leaves, and his own tail in a heap,
he sniffed the sack, and he sniffed my shoe too,
and barked, "WOOF-WOOF! I know the way! Follow me, all of you!"

Then out of the bushes hopped a little goat: HOP-LA!
"That's Pluti!" laughed Hershele. "He's coming too, no questions, ha!"
Pluti licked my cheek, and my ear, and my nose,
and took a bite of Reb Zainvel's beard: CHOMP! There it goes!

We all climbed aboard: me, the wise men and the goat, what a crew!
Chamulik ran ahead, and Hershele called, "Giddyap, Glutzi, woo-hoo!"
"We are the Wise Men of Chelm, we can solve any problem!"
Chamulik barked, "WOOF-WOOF!" and away we galloped, the whole lot of them!

And there was my house! Dad and Mom at the door!
I ran to them: a big hug, a kiss, and joy galore!
Reb Todros opened his sack: "We brought you the path, you see!"
And out of the sack flew... the yellow butterfly! Tiny and free.

I walked through the forest, one step, then one more,
so happy my heart danced like never before.
Dad on my right, and Mom on my left,
Chamulik barking "WOOF-WOOF!" and Pluti leaping, so deft!
And from the trees came voices again... do you know who? It's them!
"We are the Wise Men of Chelm, we can solve any problem!"
